finalText:
Build is clean now, exit code 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which threw and killed the link stage. Fixed it to fall back to `3` when not passed in.

The build finishes with the same 3 warnings as before (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) but 0 errors now.
